Class IntMath

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.core.math.IntMath
public final class IntMath extends Object
Arithmetic on int values that Math doesn't provide: divisors, powers, logarithms, square roots and divisions with a rounding mode, saturated arithmetic, combinatorics and primality. 
IntMath.gcd(-12, 18)                        // 6
IntMath.log2(1000, RoundingMode.CEILING)    // 10
IntMath.sqrt(99, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN)    // 10
IntMath.divide(7, 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP)  // 4
IntMath.saturatedAdd(Integer.MAX_VALUE, 1)  // Integer.MAX_VALUE
IntMath.powMod(3, 200, 1_000_000_007)       // 136318165

A method whose result may not fit in an int throws ArithmeticException when it doesn't, except pow(int, int), which wraps around like int multiplication, the saturated methods, which return Integer.MAX_VALUE or Integer.MIN_VALUE instead, and divide(int, int, RoundingMode), which overflows like Math.floorDiv(int, int).

Since:
0.2.0

  • Method Details

    • gcd

      public static int gcd(int a, int b)
      Returns the greatest common divisor of two values: the largest positive integer that divides both, or 0 if both are 0. Signs don't matter: gcd(-12, 18) is 6.
      Parameters:
      a - a value
      b - another value
      Returns:
      the greatest common divisor of a and b, never negative
      Throws:
      ArithmeticException - if the result, 2^31, doesn't fit in an int: when a and b are each Integer.MIN_VALUE or 0, but not both 0

    • lcmExact

      public static int lcmExact(int a, int b)
      Returns the least common multiple of two values: the smallest positive integer that both divide, or 0 if either is 0. Signs don't matter: lcmExact(-4, 6) is 12.
      Parameters:
      a - a value
      b - another value
      Returns:
      the least common multiple of a and b, never negative
      Throws:
      ArithmeticException - if the result doesn't fit in an int

      Returns:
      whether x is a power of two, false for 0 and negative values

    • log2

      public static int log2(int x, RoundingMode mode)
      Returns the base-2 logarithm of a value, rounded to an integer.

      A logarithm is never halfway between two integers unless it is an integer, so the HALF_ modes all round alike.

      Parameters:
      x - the value
      mode - how to round the logarithm
      Returns:
      the base-2 logarithm of x, rounded with mode
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if x isn't positive
      ArithmeticException - if mode is RoundingMode.UNNECESSARY and x isn't a power of two

    • log10

      public static int log10(int x, RoundingMode mode)
      Returns the base-10 logarithm of a value, rounded to an integer.

      A logarithm is never halfway between two integers unless it is an integer, so the HALF_ modes all round alike.

      Parameters:
      x - the value
      mode - how to round the logarithm
      Returns:
      the base-10 logarithm of x, rounded with mode
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if x isn't positive
      ArithmeticException - if mode is RoundingMode.UNNECESSARY and x isn't a power of ten

    • sqrt

      public static int sqrt(int x, RoundingMode mode)
      Returns the square root of a value, rounded to an integer.

      The square root of an integer is never halfway between two integers, so the HALF_ modes all round alike.

      Parameters:
      x - the value
      mode - how to round the square root
      Returns:
      the square root of x, rounded with mode
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if x is negative
      ArithmeticException - if mode is RoundingMode.UNNECESSARY and x isn't a perfect square

    • divide

      public static int divide(int p, int q, RoundingMode mode)
      Returns the quotient of two values, rounded to an integer.

      divide(p, q, RoundingMode.DOWN) is p / q, and divide(p, q, RoundingMode.FLOOR) is Math.floorDiv(int, int). Like them, it returns Integer.MIN_VALUE for Integer.MIN_VALUE / -1, which overflows.

      Parameters:
      p - the dividend
      q - the divisor
      mode - how to round the quotient
      Returns:
      the quotient of p by q, rounded with mode
      Throws:
      ArithmeticException - if q is 0, or if mode is RoundingMode.UNNECESSARY and q doesn't divide p

      Throws:

    • factorial

      public static int factorial(int n)

      Parameters:

      Returns:

      Throws:

    • binomial

      public static int binomial(int n, int k)
      Returns a binomial coefficient: the number of ways to choose k elements among n.
      Parameters:
      n - the number of elements
      k - the number of elements to choose
      Returns:
      n! / (k! (n - k)!)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if k is negative or exceeds n
      ArithmeticException - if the result doesn't fit in an int

    • isPrime

      public static boolean isPrime(int n)
      Returns whether a value is a prime number: an integer greater than 1 that only 1 and itself divide.

      The answer is always exact.

      Parameters:
      n - the value
      Returns:
      whether n is prime, false for values less than 2
